'''Accounts''' give your username, avatar, and room seats a persistent identity. Catanova supports Google sign-in and temporary guest accounts.

{| class="wikitable"
! Feature !! Guest !! Google-linked account
|-
| Join and create rooms || Yes || Yes
| Choose a game avatar || Yes || Yes
| Use a verified Google photo || No || Yes
| Send and receive friend requests || No || Yes
| Keep a guest username when linking || Yes, link before expiry || Same identity is retained
|}

== Your name and avatar ==
Usernames contain 3–20 letters, numbers, or underscores, using A–Z and a–z. They are unique without regard to capitalization: River and river cannot belong to different accounts. Your chosen capitalization is kept.

Choose from twelve game avatars. A Google-linked player may also use their verified Google photo.

== Guest expiry ==
A guest identity expires after '''seven days without confirmed account activity'''. Closing a tab does not immediately erase it. Clearing browser storage or signing out can lose access to that anonymous identity sooner, so link Google before relying on access from another device.

Linking Google before expiry retains your username, avatar, and ownership of your room seats. If that Google account already belongs to a different account, linking is refused rather than silently merging them or replacing the guest.

Expiry releases the username and removes access to the guest's old seats. It does not erase pieces or history from a saved game.

== Friends ==
Both players must link Google before they can become friends. Guests cannot send, receive, or accept friend requests; the app prompts them to connect an account.

Search with at least three characters from the beginning of a username. A request becomes a friendship only when the recipient accepts it.

== Leaving and reconnecting ==
Leaving a lobby frees the seat. If the host leaves, another remaining player becomes host. Leaving or disconnecting during a started game preserves the player's seat, pieces, and history.

Return with the same identity and room invitation to resume. A Google-linked identity can resume on another device; the newer connection replaces the older one. After an interrupted action, let the room synchronize before attempting it again.
